notes.title: No-Crashes Update (Hopefully)
notes.content:
After 7 years, 4 computers, moving countries, starting a family, and countless digging through so many files, I've finally created a new build of the game that should limit the amount of crashes everyone has been experiencing.

The reason for the delay is pretty simple, I thought I lost the files. I've spent hours. several times a year, digging around trying to find the them. On a fluke stroke of luck and vague memory I found them buried. I added a couple of changes to the inner workings of the base game. I played through to completion and did not get a single crash. Previously, I was experiencing the same crashes.

Final Warrior Quest should now properly run on Windows 10 and crashes down to the "acceptable" level. A fresh install and new game is heavily recommended.
